articles.title_en: Strategic mobilization of voters
articles.title_cn: 选民的战略性动员
articles.abstract_en: Organized public demonstrations of voter support for policy issues through rallies and petitions are mechanisms by which interest groups sometimes seek to influence political decision-making. We develop a voter-participation model of an interest group's strategic decision to publicly mobilize supportive voters through either a petition with zero participation cost or through a public rally with positive participation cost. Our model shows that voter mobilization can be influential when elected politicians are sufficiently uncertain about two dimensions of voters' preferences, the breadth of support for the issue and the saliency of the issue. The distribution of voter preferences – defined by the numbers of policy supporters and opposers and election vote-switchers and non-switchers – determines whether low or high participation-cost forms of mobilization are optimal. The model's predictions are consistent with recent mobilization campaigns organized by a range of interest groups, such as firms, environmental activists, and racial justice advocates.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过集会和请愿等方式，有组织地公开示威选民对政策议题的支持，是利益集团有时寻求影响政治决策的机制。我们构建了一个选民参与模型，研究利益集团通过零参与成本的请愿或正参与成本的公开集会，战略性地决定是否公开动员支持性选民。我们的模型表明，当当选的政治家对选民偏好的两个维度——议题支持的广度和议题的显著性——存在足够的不确定性时，选民动员可能具有影响力。选民偏好的分布——由政策支持者和反对者的数量以及选举中的转换者和非转换者定义——决定了低或高参与成本的动员形式是否最优。该模型的预测与近期由一系列利益集团（如企业、环保活动家和种族正义倡导者）组织的动员活动相一致。

articles.title_en: Core stability and strategy-proofness in hedonic coalition formation problems with friend-oriented preferences
articles.title_cn: 基于朋友导向偏好的享乐型联盟形成问题中的核心稳定性与策略防性
articles.abstract_en: We study hedonic coalition formation problems with friend-oriented preferences; that is, each agent has preferences over his coalitions based on a partition of the set of agents, except himself, into “friends” and “enemies” such that (E) adding an enemy makes him strictly worse off and (F) adding a friend together with a set of enemies makes him strictly better off. Friend-oriented preferences induce a so-called friendship graph where vertices are agents and directed edges point to friends.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有朋友导向偏好的享乐型联盟形成问题；即，每个代理人对他的联盟的偏好基于除他自身以外的代理人集合被划分为“朋友”和“敌人”的划分，使得（E）加入一个敌人使他严格变差，且（F）加入一个朋友连同一些敌人使他严格变好。朋友导向偏好诱导出一个所谓的友谊图，其中顶点是代理人，有向边指向朋友。

articles.title_en: A direct proof of the short-side advantage in random matching markets
articles.title_cn: 随机匹配市场中短边优势的直接证明
articles.abstract_en: We study the stable matching problem under the random matching model where the preferences of the doctors and hospitals are sampled uniformly and independently at random. In a balanced market with n doctors and n hospitals, the doctor-proposing deferred-acceptance algorithm gives doctors an expected rank of order log⁡n for their partners and hospitals an expected rank of order nlog⁡n for their partners (Pittel, 1989; Wilson, 1972). This situation is reversed in an unbalanced market with n+1 doctors and n hospitals (Ashlagi et al., 2017), a phenomenon known as the short-side advantage. The current proofs (Ashlagi et al., 2017; Cai and Thomas, 2022) of this fact are indirect, counter-intuitively being based upon analyzing the hospital-proposing deferred-acceptance algorithm. In this paper we provide a direct proof of the short-side advantage, explicitly analyzing the doctor-proposing deferred-acceptance algorithm. Our proof sheds light on how and why the phenomenon arises.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了随机匹配模型下的稳定匹配问题，其中医生和医院的偏好是均匀且独立随机抽样的。在拥有n名医生和n家医院的平衡市场中，医生提议的延迟接受算法使医生对其匹配对象的期望排名为log n阶，而医院对其匹配对象的期望排名为n/log n阶（Pittel, 1989; Wilson, 1972）。在拥有n+1名医生和n家医院的不平衡市场中，这种情况发生逆转（Ashlagi等, 2017），这一现象被称为短边优势。目前关于这一事实的证明（Ashlagi等, 2017; Cai和Thomas, 2022）是间接的，反直觉地基于分析医院提议的延迟接受算法。在本文中，我们提供了短边优势的直接证明，明确分析了医生提议的延迟接受算法。我们的证明揭示了该现象产生的方式和原因。

articles.title_en: Naive analytics: The strategic advantage of algorithmic heuristics
articles.title_cn: 朴素分析：算法启发式的战略优势
articles.abstract_en: We study interactions with uncertainty about demand sensitivity that is estimated by analytics algorithms. In our solution concept (1) firms choose seemingly optimal strategies based on estimates from possibly biased analytics algorithms, and (2) the levels of biases form best replies to one another. In equilibrium the firms' algorithms overestimate advertising effectiveness, as observed empirically, which causes advertisers to overspend. In price competitions firms also underestimate price elasticities and set prices too high. In games with strategic complements (substitutes), profits induced by such “naive analytics” equilibria Pareto dominate (are dominated by) those induced by the Nash equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在需求敏感性存在不确定性且由分析算法估计的互动。在我们的解概念中（1）企业基于可能带有偏差的分析算法的估计选择看似最优的策略，并且（2）偏差水平相互构成最佳反应。在均衡中，企业的算法高估了广告效果，正如实证观察所示，这导致广告商过度支出。在价格竞争中，企业也低估了价格弹性并设定过高的价格。在具有战略互补性（替代性）的博弈中，由这种“朴素分析”均衡所引致的利润帕累托占优（被占优于）纳什均衡所引致的利润。

articles.title_en: Political salience, endogenous bandwagoning, and regime resilience
articles.title_cn: 政治显著性、内生跟风与政权韧性
articles.abstract_en: We introduce political salience into a canonical model of attacks against political regimes, as scaling agents' expressive payoffs from taking sides. Equilibrium balances heterogeneous expressive motives with incentives to avoid sanctions by “bandwagoning” with the winning side. We examine comparative statics in political salience, which we characterize in terms of equilibrium stability as well as attack size. A main insight is that when regime sanctions are weak, increases in salience can pose the greatest threat to seemingly safe regimes: ever smaller shocks become sufficient to drastically escalate into full-blown attacks, i.e., the regime becomes less resilient. Stronger regime safeguards not only directly reduce incentives to attack but can overturn these effects, such that increases in salience boost regime resilience. Our results speak to charged debates about democratic resilience, by identifying how safeguards determine when a rise in citizen interest in political action can lead to a threat to democracy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将政治显著性引入针对政治政权攻击的经典模型中，作为扩大行动者从选边站队中获得的表达性收益的因素。均衡在异质性表达动机与通过“跟风”获胜方以避免制裁的激励之间取得平衡。我们考察了政治显著性的比较静态分析，并从均衡稳定性和攻击规模两方面对其进行刻画。一个主要见解是，当政权制裁较弱时，显著性的增加可能对看似安全的政权构成最大威胁：越来越小的冲击就足以急剧升级为全面攻击，即政权变得不那么具有韧性。更强的政权保障措施不仅直接减少攻击激励，还可能扭转这些效应，使得显著性的增加增强政权韧性。我们的研究结果涉及关于民主韧性的激烈辩论，通过识别保障措施如何决定公民对政治行动兴趣的上升何时可能对民主构成威胁。

articles.title_en: Rationalizing sharing rules
articles.title_cn: 合理化分享规则
articles.abstract_en: A partnership can yield a return—a loss or a profit relative to the partners' investments. How should the partners share the return? We identify the sharing rules satisfying classical properties (symmetry, consistency, and continuity) and avoiding arbitrary bounds on a partner's share. We show that any such rule can be rationalized in the sense that its recommendations are aligned with those maximizing a separable welfare function. Among these rules, we characterize those formalizing different notions of proportionality and, in particular, a convenient subclass specified by a single inequality aversion parameter. We also explore when a rule can be rationalized by a more general welfare function. Our central results extend to a wider class of resource allocation problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 合伙关系可以产生相对于合伙人投资的回报——损失或利润。合伙人应如何分享这一回报？我们识别出满足经典性质（对称性、一致性和连续性）并避免对合伙人份额施加任意界限的分享规则。我们证明，任何此类规则都可以被合理化，即其建议与最大化可分离福利函数的建议一致。在这些规则中，我们刻画了那些形式化不同比例概念的规则，特别是由单一不平等厌恶参数指定的便捷子类。我们还探讨了何时规则可以由更一般的福利函数合理化。我们的核心结果扩展到更广泛的资源分配问题类别。

articles.title_en: Equilibrium and social norms
articles.title_cn: 均衡与社会规范
articles.abstract_en: Richter and Rubinstein (2020) developed a novel model for social norms, which play an essential role in governing individual behavior in many economic situations. We present a generalization of the Richter-Rubinstein model allowing for an infinite agent space, individualized sets of alternatives, externalities, and intransitive preferences. In addition, we study social welfare properties of feasible Pareto efficient profiles and illustrate the applicability of our results in examples including a centrally planned economy, the classical Walrasian exchange economy, and the formation of social norms.
articles.abstract_cn: Richter和Rubinstein（2020）开发了一个新颖的社会规范模型，该模型在许多经济情境中对个体行为的治理起着至关重要的作用。我们提出了Richter-Rubinstein模型的一个推广，允许无限代理空间、个体化备选集合、外部性以及非传递性偏好。此外，我们研究了可行帕累托有效配置的社会福利性质，并通过包括中央计划经济、经典瓦尔拉斯交换经济以及社会规范形成在内的例子说明了我们结果的适用性。

articles.title_en: Interest group information in elections
articles.title_cn: 选举中的利益集团信息
articles.abstract_en: Do interest groups provide information in ways that systematically bias and polarize candidates? I consider a Downsian model where candidates are uncertain about the median voter's preference. Up to two interest groups, completely biased, observe voter preferences in the extremes and send costless messages to candidates. Starting with one interest group, I show all informative equilibria are asymmetric: the interest group “plays favorites” by revealing coarse information to one candidate, causing policy divergence. Informative equilibria exist only if the interest group has sufficiently broad information. With opposing interest groups, this requirement is relaxed. I describe equilibria where each candidate is more sensitive to voter shocks in one tail, leading to policy convergence in the center and divergence in the tails. The presence of interest groups reframes the policy space, demarcating the consensus “moderate” regions from the “extremes”.
articles.abstract_cn: 利益集团是否以系统性地偏向和极化候选人的方式提供信息？我考虑一个唐斯模型，其中候选人对中位选民偏好不确定。最多两个完全偏颇的利益集团观察选民在极端情况下的偏好，并向候选人发送无成本的信息。从一个利益集团开始，我展示了所有信息性均衡都是不对称的：利益集团通过向一位候选人揭示粗略信息来“偏袒”，导致政策分歧。信息性均衡仅在利益集团拥有足够广泛的信息时存在。当存在对立的利益集团时，这一要求放宽。我描述了每个候选人对一个尾部的选民冲击更敏感的均衡，导致中心政策趋同而尾部政策分歧。利益集团的存在重新定义了政策空间，划分了共识的“温和”区域与“极端”区域。

articles.title_en: Ambiguous persuasion: An ex-ante formulation
articles.title_cn: 模糊说服：一种事前表述
articles.abstract_en: Consider a persuasion game where both the sender and receiver are ambiguity averse with maxmin expected utility (MEU) preferences and the sender can choose an ambiguous information structure. This paper analyzes the game in an ex-ante formulation: the sender first commits to an information structure, and then the receiver best responds by choosing an ex-ante message-contingent action plan. Under this formulation, I show it is never strictly beneficial for the sender to use an ambiguous information structure as opposed to a standard unambiguous one. This result is robust to (i) the players having heterogeneous beliefs over the states, and/or (ii) the receiver having non-MEU, uncertainty-averse preferences. However, it is not robust to the sender having non-MEU preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑一个说服博弈，其中发送者和接收者都具有最大最小期望效用（MEU）偏好的模糊厌恶，且发送者可以选择模糊的信息结构。本文从事前表述的角度分析该博弈：发送者首先承诺一个信息结构，然后接收者通过选择事前依赖于信息的行动计划来最优回应。在此表述下，我证明发送者使用模糊信息结构相对于标准的不模糊信息结构永远不会严格更有利。这一结果对于（i）参与者在状态上具有异质信念，和/或（ii）接收者具有非MEU、不确定性厌恶偏好是稳健的。然而，对于发送者具有非MEU偏好的情况，这一结果并不稳健。

articles.title_en: Non-isolation, reversals, and social preference
articles.title_cn: 非隔离性、反转与社会偏好
articles.abstract_en: Recent evidence suggests that non-isolation behavior could significantly impact laboratory experiments using the random problem selection (RPS) payment mechanism through lottery integration. Theoretical work also highlights social preferences that can violate statewise monotonicity, a necessary and sufficient condition for incentive compatibility with the RPS payment mechanism in case of lottery integration. Additionally, non-isolation can influence decisions through non-consequential dynamic concerns. In a series of three simple and parsimonious experiments and three tests, we examine the occurrence of the two kinds of non-isolation and reversal behaviors. We find significant evidence for positive reversal behavior, where subjects are more likely to make a fair choice if there is an alternative possible realization of an unfair outcome (which they chose themselves). In addition, the lower bounds for the prevalence of non-isolation in terms of lottery integration and dynamic non-consequential concern are estimated to be approximately 10% and 20%, respectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期证据表明，非隔离行为可能通过彩票整合显著影响使用随机问题选择（RPS）支付机制的实验室实验。理论研究还强调了可能违反状态单调性的社会偏好，而状态单调性是RPS支付机制在彩票整合情况下激励相容的必要且充分条件。此外，非隔离性可以通过非结果主义的动态关切影响决策。在一系列三个简单且简约的实验中，以及三项测试中，我们考察了两种非隔离性和反转行为的发生情况。我们发现显著的正向反转行为证据，即如果存在一个不公平结果的替代可能实现（由他们自己选择），受试者更可能做出公平选择。此外，非隔离性在彩票整合和动态非结果主义关切方面的普遍性下限估计分别约为10%和20%。

articles.title_en: Material incentives and effort choice: Evidence from an online experiment across countries
articles.title_cn: 物质激励与努力选择：一项跨国在线实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct an interactive online experiment framed as an employment contract. Subjects from the US, India, and Africa are matched within and across countries. Employers make a one-period offer to a worker who can either decline or choose a high or low effort. The offer is restricted to be from a variable set of possible contracts. High effort is always efficient. Some observed choices are well predicted by self-interest, but others are better explained by conditional reciprocity or intrinsic motivation. Subjects from India and Africa follow intrinsic motivation and provide high effort more often. US subjects are more likely to follow self-interest and reach a less efficient outcome on average, but workers earn slightly more. We find no evidence of stereotypes across countries. Individual characteristics and stated attitudes toward worker incentives do not predict the behavioral differences observed between countries, consistent with cultural differences in the response to labor incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开展了一项以雇佣合同为框架的交互式在线实验。来自美国、印度和非洲的受试者在国家内部及跨国之间进行匹配。雇主向工人提供一期合同，工人可以选择拒绝或选择高努力或低努力。合同被限制在一组可变的可能合同中。高努力总是有效率的。一些观察到的选择能很好地由自利预测，但其他选择则更好地由条件互惠或内在动机解释。来自印度和非洲的受试者遵循内在动机，更常提供高努力。美国受试者更可能遵循自利，平均达到效率较低的结果，但工人赚得略多。我们未发现跨国的刻板印象证据。个体特征和对工人激励的陈述态度不能预测国家间观察到的行为差异，这与对劳动激励反应的跨文化差异一致。

articles.title_en: A concavity in the value of information
articles.title_cn: 信息价值中的凹性
articles.abstract_en: A natural way of quantifying the “amount of information” in decision problems yields a globally concave value for information. Another (in contrast, adversarial) way almost never does.
articles.abstract_cn: 在决策问题中，一种自然的量化“信息量”的方式会产生全局凹的信息价值。另一种（相比之下，对抗性的）方式则几乎从不如此。

articles.title_en: Approximately fair and population consistent budget division via simple payment schemes
articles.title_cn: 通过简单支付方案的近似公平与人口一致性预算分配
articles.abstract_en: In approval-based budget division, a budget needs to be distributed to some candidates based on the voters' approval ballots over these candidates. In the pursuit of a simple, consistent, and approximately fair rule for this setting, we introduce the maximum payment rule (MP). Under this rule, each voter controls a part of the budget and, in each step, the corresponding voters allocate their entire budget to the candidate approved by the largest number of voters with non-zero budget. We show that MP meets our criteria as it satisfies monotonicity and a demanding population consistency condition and gives a 2-approximation to a fairness notion called average fair share (AFS). Moreover, we generalize MP to the class of sequential payment rules and prove that it is the most desirable rule within this class: nearly all other sequential payment rules fail monotonicity while offering only small improvements in the approximation ratio to AFS.
articles.abstract_cn: 在基于批准的预算分配中，需要根据选民对这些候选人的批准选票将预算分配给某些候选人。为了寻求一种简单、一致且近似公平的规则，我们引入了最大支付规则（MP）。在此规则下，每位选民控制预算的一部分，并且在每一步中，相应的选民将其全部预算分配给获得非零预算选民中最多人数批准的候选人。我们证明MP满足我们的标准，因为它满足单调性和一个要求严格的人口一致性条件，并且对称为平均公平份额（AFS）的公平概念给出了2-近似。此外，我们将MP推广到顺序支付规则类别，并证明它是该类别中最理想的规则：几乎所有其他顺序支付规则都未能满足单调性，同时仅在对AFS的近似比率上提供小幅改进。

articles.title_en: Teams formation: Efficiency and approximate fairness
articles.title_cn: 团队形成：效率与近似公平
articles.abstract_en: A set of kn indivisible items is to be allocated to n agents; each agent has to get exactly k items, and agents have additive utilities over bundles. Can one find an efficient and approximately fair allocation? In this setting, we introduce new notions of approximate fairness, based on exchange of two single objects, and compare them to the “traditional” ones based on disregarding one object.
articles.abstract_cn: 一组kn个不可分割的物品将被分配给n个代理人；每个代理人必须恰好获得k个物品，且代理人对捆绑具有加性效用。能否找到一种既高效又近似公平的分配方案？在此设定下，我们引入了基于两个单一物品交换的近似公平新概念，并将其与基于忽略一个物品的“传统”概念进行比较。

articles.title_en: Who gets the credit? Credit attribution, spillovers, and inefficiency in teams
articles.title_cn: 谁获得功劳？团队中的功劳归属、溢出效应与效率损失
articles.abstract_en: We examine team incentives in environments with positive spillovers and rewards based on ex-post public credit for collective success. Compared to the ex-ante efficient credit allocation that maximizes the team's overall payoff, ex-post credit distorts individual incentives: higher-ability or lower-cost agents receive excessive credit and overexert effort when spillovers are low, but are under-credited and insufficiently motivated when spillovers are high. To address these inefficiencies, organizations may optimally limit spillovers by restricting peer communication or reducing transparency in teamwork. Moreover, concerns about credit-sharing can deter agents from inviting collaborators or selecting the most capable partners when leading projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有正溢出效应和基于事后公开功劳奖励的环境中团队激励问题。与最大化团队整体收益的事前有效功劳分配相比，事后功劳分配扭曲了个人激励：当溢出效应较低时，能力较高或成本较低的代理人获得过多功劳并过度付出努力；而当溢出效应较高时，他们获得的功劳不足且激励不够。为了解决这些效率损失，组织可能通过限制同伴沟通或降低团队工作透明度来最优地限制溢出效应。此外，对功劳分享的担忧可能会阻止代理人在领导项目时邀请合作者或选择最有能力的伙伴。

articles.title_en: Information unraveling and limited depth of reasoning
articles.title_cn: 信息揭示与推理深度有限
articles.abstract_en: Information unraveling is an elegant theoretical argument suggesting that private information is voluntarily and fully revealed in many circumstances. However, the experimental literature has documented many cases of incomplete unraveling and has suggested limited depth of reasoning on the part of senders as a behavioral explanation. To test this explanation, we modify the design of existing unraveling games along two dimensions. In contrast to the baseline setting with simultaneous moves, we introduce a variant where decision-making is essentially sequential. Second, we vary the cost of disclosure, resulting in a 2×2 treatment design. Both sequential decision-making and low disclosure costs are suitable for reducing the demands on subjects' level-k reasoning. The data confirm that sequential decision-making and low disclosure costs lead to more disclosure, and there is virtually full disclosure in the treatment that combines both. A calibrated level-k model makes quantitative predictions, including precise treatment level and player-specific revelation rates, and these predictions organize the data well. The timing of decisions provides further insights into the treatment-specific unraveling process.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息揭示是一个优雅的理论论证，表明在许多情况下私人信息会被自愿且完全地披露。然而，实验文献记录了诸多不完全揭示的案例，并提出发送者推理深度有限作为行为解释。为检验这一解释，我们从两个维度修改了现有揭示博弈的设计。与同时行动的基线设置相比，我们引入了一个决策本质上是序贯的变体。其次，我们改变披露成本，形成2×2的处理设计。序贯决策和低披露成本都适合降低对受试者水平-k推理的要求。数据证实，序贯决策和低披露成本导致更多披露，而在结合两者的处理中几乎实现了完全披露。校准的水平-k模型做出了定量预测，包括精确的处理水平和参与者特定的揭示率，这些预测很好地组织了数据。决策的时机为进一步理解特定处理的揭示过程提供了洞见。

articles.title_en: BAR Nash equilibrium and application to blockchain design
articles.title_cn: BAR纳什均衡及其在区块链设计中的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel solution concept, called BAR Nash Equilibrium (BARNE) and applies it to the Verifier's Dilemma, a fundamental problem in the design of blockchain consensus. BARNE extends the Nash Equilibrium (NE) to accommodate interactions among Byzantine, altruistic, and rational agents, known as the BAR setting in the distributed computing literature. We prove the existence of BARNE in a broad class of games and introduce two refinements: global stability and local stability. We demonstrate that in the classical quorum-based blockchain protocol, honestly following the prescribed strategy is not a locally stable BARNE, whereas free-riding is a globally stable BARNE. To address this, we designed a more robust protocol with the same classical guarantees, by incorporating fines and forced errors. Under this new protocol, honesty becomes the unique globally stable BARNE, and free-riding is never a BARNE.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的解概念，称为BAR纳什均衡（BARNE），并将其应用于验证者困境，这是区块链共识设计中的一个基本问题。BARNE扩展了纳什均衡（NE），以适应分布式计算文献中已知的BAR设置中拜占庭、利他和理性代理之间的交互。我们证明了在一大类博弈中BARNE的存在性，并引入了两个精炼：全局稳定性和局部稳定性。我们证明，在经典的基于法定人数的区块链协议中，诚实地遵循规定策略不是局部稳定的BARNE，而搭便车是全局稳定的BARNE。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了一个更健壮的协议，通过引入罚款和强制错误，保持了相同的经典保证。在这个新协议下，诚实成为唯一的全局稳定BARNE，而搭便车永远不是BARNE。

articles.title_en: Reasoning about your own future mistakes
articles.title_cn: 关于自身未来错误的推理
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of reasoning in dynamic games in which a player, at each information set, holds a conditional belief about his own future choices and the opponents' future choices. These conditional beliefs are assumed to be cautious, that is, the player never completely rules out any feasible future choice by himself or the opponents. We impose the following key conditions: (a) a player always believes that he will choose rationally in the future, (b) a player always believes that his opponents will choose rationally in the future, and (c) a player deems his own mistakes infinitely less likely than the opponents' mistakes. These conditions, together with iterating property (b), lead to the new concept of perfect backwards rationalizability. We show that perfect backwards rationalizable strategies exist in every finite dynamic game. We prove, moreover, that perfect backwards rationalizability constitutes a refinement of both perfect rationalizability (a rationalizability analogue to Selten's (1975) perfect equilibrium) and procedural quasi-perfect rationalizability (a rationalizability analogue to van Damme's (1984) quasi-perfect equilibrium) – two concepts that are introduced in this paper. As a consequence, our concept avoids both weakly dominated strategies in the normal form and strategies containing weakly dominated actions in the agent normal form. For one-shot games, the concept coincides with permissibility (Brandenburger (1992), Börgers (1994)).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个动态博弈中的推理模型，在该模型中，参与人在每个信息集上持有关于自身未来选择和对手未来选择的条件信念。这些条件信念被假定为谨慎的，即参与人从不完全排除自己或对手的任何可行未来选择。我们施加以下关键条件：(a) 参与人始终相信自己在未来会理性选择，(b) 参与人始终相信对手在未来会理性选择，以及 (c) 参与人认为自己的错误比对手的错误无限地更不可能。这些条件，连同性质(b)的迭代，引出了完美后向理性化这一新概念。我们证明，在每个有限动态博弈中都存在完美后向理性化策略。此外，我们证明完美后向理性化构成了完美理性化（Selten (1975) 完美均衡的理性化类比）和程序性准完美理性化（van Damme (1984) 准完美均衡的理性化类比）的细化——这两个概念在本文中引入。因此，我们的概念在规范形式中避免了弱支配策略，在代理规范形式中避免了包含弱支配行动的策略。对于一次性博弈，该概念与可容许性（Brandenburger (1992)，Börgers (1994)）一致。

articles.title_en: Evidence games: Lying aversion and commitment
articles.title_cn: 证据博弈：说谎厌恶与承诺
articles.abstract_en: The voluntary disclosure literature suggests that in evidence games, where the informed sender chooses which pieces of evidence to disclose to the uninformed receiver who determines their payoff, commitment does not matter, as there is a theoretical equivalence between the optimal mechanism and the game equilibrium outcomes. In this paper, we experimentally investigate whether the optimal mechanism and the game equilibrium outcomes coincide in a simple evidence game. Contrary to the theoretical equivalence, our results indicate that outcomes diverge and that commitment changes the outcomes. Our experimental results are in line with the predictions of a model that accounts for lying-averse agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 自愿披露文献表明，在证据博弈中，知情发送者选择向决定其收益的不知情接收者披露哪些证据，承诺并不重要，因为最优机制与博弈均衡结果之间存在理论等价性。在本文中，我们通过实验研究在一个简单的证据博弈中，最优机制与博弈均衡结果是否一致。与理论等价性相反，我们的结果表明结果出现分歧，且承诺改变了结果。我们的实验结果与考虑说谎厌恶主体的模型预测一致。

articles.title_en: Stochastic adaptive learning with committed players in games with strict Nash equilibria
articles.title_cn: 具有严格纳什均衡的博弈中带有承诺参与者的随机自适应学习
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the convergence properties of an adaptive learning model that overlaps those of stochastic fictitious play learning and experience-weighted attraction learning in normal form games with strict Nash equilibria. In particular, we consider the case in which adaptive players play a game against not only other adaptive players but also committed players, who do not revise their behaviour but follow a fixed (strict Nash equilibrium or corresponding logit quantal response equilibrium) action. We then provide conditions under which the adaptive learning process, the choice probability profile of adaptive players, almost surely converges to the logit quantal response equilibrium that committed players follow. We also provide conditions under which the adaptive learning process of a more general adaptive learning model which overlaps those of payoff assessment learning and delta learning converges to a logit quantal response equilibrium different from the equilibrium that committed players follow with positive probability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个自适应学习模型的收敛性质，该模型在具有严格纳什均衡的正则形式博弈中，与随机虚拟博弈学习和经验加权吸引力学习有所重叠。特别地，我们考虑了自适应参与者不仅与其他自适应参与者博弈，还与承诺参与者博弈的情况，承诺参与者不修正其行为，而是遵循固定的（严格纳什均衡或相应的logit分位数响应均衡）行动。然后，我们提供了条件，在这些条件下，自适应学习过程，即自适应参与者的选择概率分布，几乎必然收敛到承诺参与者所遵循的logit分位数响应均衡。我们还提供了条件，在这些条件下，一个更一般的自适应学习模型（与支付评估学习和delta学习重叠）的自适应学习过程，以正概率收敛到一个不同于承诺参与者所遵循的均衡的logit分位数响应均衡。

articles.title_en: Robust price discrimination
articles.title_cn: 稳健的价格歧视
articles.abstract_en: We consider a model of third-degree price discrimination where the seller's product valuation is unknown to the market designer, who aims to maximize buyer surplus by revealing buyer valuation information. Our main result shows that the regret is bounded by a 1e-fraction of the optimal buyer surplus when the seller has zero valuation for the product. This bound is attained by randomly drawing a seller valuation and applying the segmentation of Bergemann et al. (2015) with respect to the drawn valuation. We show that this bound is tight in the case of binary buyer valuation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个三级价格歧视模型，其中卖方的产品估值对市场设计者未知，市场设计者旨在通过揭示买方估值信息来最大化买方剩余。我们的主要结果表明，当卖方对产品的估值为零时，遗憾值以最优买方剩余的1e分之一为界。该界限通过随机抽取一个卖方估值并应用Bergemann等人（2015）关于所抽取估值的分割来实现。我们证明在买方估值为二元的情况下，该界限是紧的。

articles.title_en: Unfounded opinion's curse
articles.title_cn: 无根据意见的诅咒
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of uninformed agents in information aggregation. A group of agents, who may or may not have private information about the state, communicate through a specific communication format and vote to make the correct decision—one that matches an unobservable state—based on majority rule. We analyzed efficient equilibria under simultaneous and sequential communication formats and tested these predictions in the laboratory. When all agents were informed, information was aggregated efficiently regardless of the format. However, when some agents were uninformed, the communication format significantly affected information aggregation. Specifically, although the probability of correct group decisions closely aligned with the rational benchmark under sequential communication, it was significantly lower under simultaneous communication, as unfounded opinions undermined information aggregation. We argue that the positive effect of sequential communication can be attributed to the social facilitation effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了无信息代理在信息聚合中的作用。一组代理，可能拥有也可能不拥有关于状态的私人信息，通过特定的沟通格式进行交流，并根据多数规则投票做出正确决策——即与不可观测状态相匹配的决策。我们分析了在同步和顺序沟通格式下的有效均衡，并在实验室中测试了这些预测。当所有代理都有信息时，无论格式如何，信息都能有效聚合。然而，当一些代理无信息时，沟通格式显著影响信息聚合。具体来说，尽管在顺序沟通下，群体正确决策的概率与理性基准紧密一致，但在同步沟通下，这一概率显著较低，因为无根据的意见破坏了信息聚合。我们认为，顺序沟通的积极效应可归因于社会促进效应。

articles.title_en: Markovian persuasion with stochastic revelations
articles.title_cn: 具有随机揭示的马尔可夫说服
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines information transmission games where the sender knows the realizations of states from a Markov process, but his informational advantage is counteracted by outside, random revelations to the receiver. For very patient players, we characterize the sender's value of the game with outside revelations in terms of the value without outside revelations. Through our characterization, we identify that, in contrast with the sender-receiver games with fixed states, the sender may benefit from being patient: his discounted value of the game may increase as the discount factor grows.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了信息传递博弈，其中发送者知道来自马尔可夫过程的现实状态，但他的信息优势被外部对接收者的随机揭示所抵消。对于非常耐心的参与者，我们通过无外部揭示时的价值来刻画有外部揭示时发送者的博弈价值。通过我们的刻画，我们发现，与固定状态的发送者-接收者博弈相反，发送者可能从耐心中受益：随着贴现因子的增加，他的博弈贴现价值可能会增加。
